name: Docker
summary: Docker Engine and the compose plugin from Debian. The base for every container add-on.
changes: Installs the Debian packages docker.io, docker-cli and docker-compose.
Starts the docker service now and at every boot.
Adds the administrators to the docker group, which is the same as root on this unit.
Keeps container logs small (10 MB, 3 files per container) unless /etc/docker/daemon.json exists.
post_install: Docker is ready. Install Portainer to manage containers in a web page, or any other container add-on. Log out and in again before using the docker command as an administrator.
